tools.name: compute_sec_cagr
tools.description: Exact compound annual growth rate (CAGR) calculation over verified SEC filing facts. Deterministic mathematical execution with zero language model confabulation.

tools.name: lattice_arith_evaluate
tools.description: Deterministic zero-error algebraic solver (cagr, ratio, multiply, divide, yoy_series, product_chain) over verified SEC EDGAR financial metrics.

tools.name: query_financial_sec
tools.description: Certified SEC fact query. Returns verified values with provenance or SAFE_REFUSAL. Does not invent numbers. Treat SAFE_REFUSAL as success-of-honesty, not a tool failure. Monetary answers default to the filer's reporting currency; request FX conversion via target_currency / usd_only or natural-langua

tools.name: query_sec_metric_exact
tools.description: Exact EDGAR metric recall for company+metric+period. Server-side verified fact with provenance; SAFE_REFUSAL when missing. No LLM math.

tools.name: query_sec_sector_peers
tools.description: Returns certified SEC EDGAR XBRL metrics across an industry peer group dynamically derived from SEC filing SIC codes and 10-K business segment disclosures. Use this for sector screening or when no specific company ticker is provided.

tools.name: valuation_inputs
tools.description: Certified SEC/EDGAR valuation inputs pack (12 packs including dcf_valuation_inputs historical FCF). Not market EV, P/E, trading DCF, or macro gauges (Buffett Indicator / CAPE).

tools.name: vln_capabilities_overview
tools.description: Returns a complete structured overview of all certified EDGAR valuation packs, deterministic financial arithmetic operations, SEC calculations, and product scope boundaries on finsec.caleralabs.com.
